item.title: 1935 Delahaye 135 Coupe des Alpes by Autobineau Project
item.description: This 1935 Delahaye 135 is a right-hand-drive “Coupe des Alpes” model with coachwork by Autobineau and a 3,227cc OHV inline-six equipped with triple Solex carburetors. Chassis 46074 was first registered near Paris and remained in France for more than five decades, changing hands several times. In the late 1980s, the car was brought to Japan, where it spent time at the Yuzen Museum in Chiba. item.title: 21k-Mile 1999 BMW M Coupe
item.description: This 1999 BMW M Coupe is a black-over-black example with 21k miles. Power is provided by a 3.2-liter S52 inline-six linked with a five-speed manual transmission, and equipment includes a limited-slip differential, a sunroof, 17" Style 40 wheels, heated sport seats, a Harman Kardon sound system, air conditioning, and cruise control. item.description: This 1993 Mazda RX-7 Touring is said to have remained under the care of its original owner until the seller's purchase in 2012, and it now has 31k miles following registration history in Colorado and Arizona. Finished in Silver Stone Metallic over black leather upholstery, it is powered by a twin-turbocharged 1.3-liter Wankel rotary engine mated to a five-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 1971 DeTomaso Pantera
item.description: This 1971 DeTomaso Pantera was acquired new by the original owner from McCormick Lincoln-Mercury, Inc. of Trenton, New Jersey, in 1971. Following a color change from white to red in 1985, chassis 02210 is said to have been kept in storage from 2002 to 2022 before being acquired by the current owner from the original owner in 2024. item.title: BaT Meet-Up, February 21 at Desert Dunes in Palm Springs, California
item.description: Even if your holiday decor is still up (we won’t judge), heed the call of the calendar's turning—BaT’s 2026 event season is here! We’re excited to announce that our first Meet-Up of the year will be hosted at the future home of Desert Dunes Preserve, a project of Oswit Land Trust, in Palm Springs. The event will take place on Saturday, February 21, from 9:00am to 1:00pm, and is free to attend for all!

item.title: 1,900-Mile 2017 Ferrari F12tdf
